purpose: Machine-readable dispatch contract for process-planning. Hooks read this as fallback ground truth when transcript classification is missing or truncated (H11 audit finding 2026-04-18). Prose contract in SKILL.md remains canonical for agent guidance; this file mirrors it for enforcement.

mandatory_dispatches.name: implementation-plan
mandatory_dispatches.notes: Produces the plan artifact with sequenced steps + acceptance criteria.

mandatory_dispatches.name: architect-reviewer
mandatory_dispatches.notes: Post-plan review — SKILL.md marks this MUST dispatch unconditionally.

mandatory_dispatches.name: adversarial-reviewer
mandatory_dispatches.notes: Classifier floor rule: Planning → adversarial-reviewer always required (every plan gets challenged before committing).

conditional_dispatches.name: prompt-engineer
conditional_dispatches.condition: plan involves LLM prompts or agent design

conditional_dispatches.name: mcp-server-architect
conditional_dispatches.notes: MUST DISPATCH per architecture-v2 Delta-1 close-out (GAP-5 binding, 2026-07-10); runs alongside implementation-plan. mcp-developer is named in the resulting plan as the bound downstream build-phase implementer (see the matching mandatory-dispatch row in process-build/DISPATCHES.json) but is not itself dispatched during planning.

notes: Research compound must route through process-research per 2026-04-18 H10 fix; do NOT dispatch technical-researcher or research-analyst directly from process-planning. 2026-08-30 content review: added mcp-server-architect as a conditional MUST DISPATCH for MCP-domain planning (SKILL.md Step 3 states it as mandatory; the JSON had no MCP entry at all); rest of the file confirmed current against SKILL.md and process-planning.js. 2026-09-15 content review: sibling drift since 2026-08-30 is the O9 WORKFLOW-ID wrapper only (every agent() call became wfAgent(), which prefixes the prompt and changes nothing else); dispatch set unchanged, contract still accurate.
